investigator.method: Phase B deep-dive activation-readiness investigation (BEATMAPPED-LONDON-SECOND-LIVE-TRANCHE-01), superseding the Level-1 triage london-t2-eventim-apollo-01. Escalates to Level 2 STRUCTURAL: real unauthenticated GETs (curl, descriptive research User-Agent, redirects followed, 20s timeout, no retry, no auth/CAPTCHA-bypass, no browser) to the events index page and three real individual event detail pages, comparing JSON-LD, list-card markup and hero-detail markup across all four retrieved pages to classify acquisition method and assess every governed field.

probe_history.reason: Mirrors/cites the prior investigation london-t2-eventim-apollo-01's own retained Level 1 PASSIVE_STATIC probe (a single bounded GET to the /events index page performed as part of a triage-refinement batch). That probe was SUFFICIENT for its own narrower music-relevance question but honestly left every field_assessment key at UNKNOWN/PARTIAL -- no per-event field extraction, acquisition_class beyond a provisional STATIC_HTML guess, or offline proof was attempted at Level 1. This record continues that investigation rather than repeating it: Level 1 is retained here as INSUFFICIENT for the deep-dive activation-readiness questions this package must answer.

Real unauthenticated GETs to the /events/ events index page and three real individual /events/<slug> detail pages (Judas Priest, Europe, Amon Amarth) fully answered every open question: the platform is a custom AEG-hosted venue CMS (aeg-media-assets.b-cdn.net asset CDN; identical event-hero__title/card__title/card--horizontal markup conventions to the sibling AEG venue Watford Colosseum); every page carries exactly one application/ld+json block (WebSite/MusicVenue/BreadcrumbList) and never a per-event schema.org Event/MusicEvent block; each event's own title, complete day+month+year date, and a doors time (from a per-event 'showings' table also repeating the date) are stated directly and unambiguously in plain server-rendered HTML on both the list card and the detail page hero. The venue's full street address, absent from the JSON-LD itself, is stated directly as plain text in the site's own footer navigation link on every page. No JS bootstrap/page-data blob, private endpoint, or client-side rendering was found or needed -- static structural inspection fully exposed the acquisition path, so no Level 3 browser observation was required.

identity.notes: Prior investigation already proved identity from the retained /events index response's own <title> and roster. This record's retained /events index and all three retained event detail pages carry the identical JSON-LD identity block ({"@type":"MusicVenue","name":"Eventim Apollo"}), and the site's own footer navigation link states the full venue name plus address directly and identically on every retrieved page ("Eventim Apollo, 45 Queen Caroline Street, London, England W6 9QH" -- the venue formerly known as Hammersmith Apollo), and every detail page's own JSON-LD mainEntityOfPage/BreadcrumbList entries self-declare the page as https://www.eventimapollo.com/events/<slug>.

site_classification.platform: Custom AEG-hosted venue site (same platform family as sibling AEG venue Watford Colosseum -- shared aeg-media-assets.b-cdn.net CDN and shared event-hero__title / card__title / card--horizontal markup conventions). The events index page and individual /events/<slug> detail pages are all server-rendered plain HTML with no client-side rendering required to expose event data. A single schema.org JSON-LD block (WebSite/MusicVenue/BreadcrumbList) is present on every page retrieved, but no page anywhere in the retained sample carries a schema.org Event/MusicEvent JSON-LD block -- title/date/doors-time are only ever present as plain HTML text.

title.notes: Each sampled event's own <h1 class="event-hero__title"> on its detail page (and matching <h3 class="card__title"> on the list page) states the full title directly -- no combination required. Verified identically for all three sampled events (Judas Priest, Europe, Amon Amarth); reproduced offline against the retained fixture (ev-derive-script/ev-derive-output).

blockers.description: ingestion/static-cards/collector.mjs's CARD_START regex requires an event/programme/calendar keyword to appear BEFORE a card/item keyword within the card wrapper's own class attribute. This source's real card wrapper class is 'card h-full  card--horizontal' (retained in ev-events-index) -- it contains no event/programme/calendar keyword at all, so CARD_START would not match this venue's real markup as currently written (an even more pronounced instance of the same mismatch found at sibling venue Watford Colosseum). card-date.mjs's COMPLETE_TEXT_DATE date-resolution path already handles the venue's actual complete-text date format ('Monday 21st September 2026') without any change. Widening CARD_START to be keyword-order-independent (or matching on the leaf 'card__title'/'card__info' classes instead of the outer wrapper) is a small, well-scoped collector change to an existing family, not a new family.

reasons: Identity is PROVEN (identical retained JSON-LD MusicVenue block plus the site's own footer address text on all four retrieved pages, matching the known venue -- formerly Hammersmith Apollo -- exactly).

Acquisition class is STATIC_HTML, a resolved/supported class: the events index page and every sampled event detail page are plain, server-rendered HTML reachable via a single unauthenticated GET each, with no JSON-LD Event objects and no client-side rendering required.
A confirmed public data path exists (the /events/ index page plus three confirmed individual event detail pages).

title.state and start_date.state are both PROVEN with basis DIRECT_SOURCE for all three sampled real events (Judas Priest 2026-09-21, Europe 2026-10-03, Amon Amarth 2026-10-10) -- no invented year or date at any point.
source_record_id.state is PROVEN using the site's own declared canonical per-event URL (JSON-LD mainEntityOfPage), satisfying the stable identifier rule via self-documented stability.

collector_assessment.recommended_family is STATIC_EVENT_LIST, an existing, already-implemented family (ingestion/static-cards/) -- the sole blocker is MINOR (a regex widening, not a new architecture) and does not block activation.

The DIRECT_SOURCE title/start_date parse-out was reproduced offline, deterministically, against the retained fixture with zero network access (ev-derive-script/ev-derive-output, all_match: true across all three sampled events), satisfying the general offline-proof gate.
